=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2496 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The warning message in _merge_lease_max_holders includes raw, unescaped user-provided input from an environment variable.
  WHY: An attacker can inject arbitrary characters (e.g., control sequences) into the workflow logs, potentially misleading users or disrupting log analysis tools (source severity NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state the value is filtered through `tr -cd '0-9A-Za-z_-' | cut -c1-32` before interpolation and call the claim wrong).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1980 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The grant loop in _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi performs overlap calculations before validating the candidate's head SHA or checking if the PR files read succeeded.
  WHY: If the files read fails, _merge_lease_pr_paths returns `*` (fail-closed, treated as overlapping everything), so an unreadable candidate might incorrectly block, or be blocked by, other PRs, leading to a lease grant failure or a stuck PR (source severity MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state this is the documented fail-closed design, not a defect).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2791-2826 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The commit message for lease writes is constructed using shell string concatenation in _merge_lease_cas_commit.
  WHY: If the commit message content (which includes paths) grows very large, it could theoretically exceed shell ARG_MAX limits or trigger parsing issues if paths contain unexpected characters, though sanitization helpers attempt to mitigate this (source severity NIT; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash calls the ARG_MAX finding a speculative pattern-match).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
